I only had the one video, so I haven't tested it on others.\n\nI compared those two frames against contact sheets of the jump. Takeoff 54 is the first frame where the trailing foot clearly leaves the ground. Landing 62 is the first frame where the lead foot is back on the track. Both are plausible, but the exact takeoff and landing frames are a judgment call, so they could be off by a frame.\n\nHow it works:\n1.
